title: Semio Store Graphql Api
description: Replace semio-store JSON-RPC with GraphQL over HTTP, wire native KitStore for backbone commands, add GraphiQL dev config in launch.json.
summary: Added a pre-install GraphiQL preview runtime so read/introspection queries execute against an empty in-memory kit without occupying the real install slot. Real mutations and subscriptions still return the no-kit JSON error until POST /install succeeds. Updated the existing GraphiQL integration test to assert pre-install query success and pre-install mutation rejection. Verified cargo test -p semio-store with ticket-local CARGO_TARGET_DIR and loaded /graphiql in Playwright without no-kit, response-is-not-defined, or Unexpected-token runtime errors.
